rowCount.description:
The number of rows. This rowCount can be for a single subject or for the total of a batch of subjects, depending on
where this meta type is used.

inMemorySize.description: The memory size of the serialized {@link Data.Column}s subjects. The unit of the memory size is Byte.

bytes.description: The serialized {@link Data.Column}s as bytes subjects.

title: This type stores the aggregated meta information created while serializing Data.Columns.
name: Data.Column.SerFields
